types: DuckDB sqlite_scan read every table with its declared type under SQLite's affinity rules: any INT type to bigint, REAL to double, char(n), varchar(n) and json to string, BLOB to binary, date and datetime to date and timestamp. No table needed the Python fallback reader.
views: Six SQLite views (da1, dae1, dap1, de1, sig1, uni1) are queries over x4pro_c5dat and the index tables, not stored tables. They are not converted; their SQL is under views_not_converted.
partitioning: none; tables over 400 MB are written as several files in source order
